items.a: Chatbot testing checks that an AI chatbot gives correct, safe and grounded answers and completes the tasks users bring to it. For broader coverage see conversational AI testing.

items.q: How do you test an AI chatbot?
items.a: Generate test conversations from your source documents, run them against the chatbot, and score each conversation on metrics such as hallucination, bias and task completion.

items.q: How does TestMu AI detect hallucinations?
items.a: Each answer is compared with the documents the chatbot should use. Answers not supported by the source are flagged.
Any chatbot with a reachable endpoint or web widget, built on any model or vendor.
